        output_lines.append("        if string[0] == '-':\n")

        output_lines.append('            sign = 1\n')
        output_lines.append('\n')
        output_lines.append('        base = self.base\n')
        output_lines.append("        if string[0] == '0' and len(string) > 2:\n")
        output_lines.append("            if string[1] in 'bB':\n")

        output_lines.append("            elif string[1] in 'oO':\n")

        output_lines.append('                base = 16\n')
        output_lines.append('\n')
        output_lines.append('        chars = self.CHARS[:base]\n')
        output_lines.append("        string = re.sub('[^%s]' % chars, '', string.lower())\n")
        output_lines.append('        return sign * int(string, base)\n')
        output_lines.append('\n')
        output_lines.append('\n')
        output_lines.append('def int_convert(base):\n')
        output_lines.append('    return IntConverter(base)\n')
        
        # Skip until we find the next def/class at module level (the one after int_convert)
        i += 1
        while i < len(lines):
            l = lines[i]
            if l.strip().startswith('def ') and not l.startswith('    '):
                break
            i += 1
        continue
    
    # R7: Replace lambda for float conversion (type 'f')
    if "elif type == 'f':" in line:

        # Next line should be s = ...
        output_lines.append(lines[i])
        i += 1
        # Replace the lambda assignment

        continue
    
    # R7: Replace lambda for Decimal conversion (type 'F')

        i += 1
        output_lines.append(lines[i])
        i += 1
        output_lines.append('            self._type_conversions[group] = DecimalConverter()\n')

    # R7: Replace lambda for e conversion

        i += 1
        output_lines.append(lines[i])
        i += 1
        output_lines.append('            self._type_conversions[group] = FloatConverter()\n')

        i += 1
        output_lines.append(lines[i])

        output_lines.append('            self._type_conversions[group] = FloatConverter()\n')

        # skip the _group_index line  
        output_lines.append(lines[i])

    # R7: Replace custom type converter inner function with class
    if '            def f(string, m):' in line and 'return type_converter(string)' in lines[i+1]:
        output_lines.append('            self._type_conversions[group] = CustomTypeConverter(type_converter)\n')
        i += 2  # skip the two lines of the old inner function
        continue
    
    # Add FloatConverter class before percentage function
    if 'def percentage(string, match):' in line:
        # Insert the converter classes before this
        output_lines.append('class FloatConverter:\n')
        output_lines.append('    """Convert a string to a float."""\n')
        output_lines.append('    def __call__(self, s, m):\n')
        output_lines.append('        return float(s)\n')
        output_lines.append('\n')
        output_lines.append('\n')
        output_lines.append('class DecimalConverter:\n')
        output_lines.append('    """Convert a string to a Decimal."""\n')
        output_lines.append('    def __call__(self, s, m):\n')
        output_lines.append('        return Decimal(s)\n')
        output_lines.append('\n')
        output_lines.append('\n')
        output_lines.append('class CustomTypeConverter:\n')
        output_lines.append('    """Wrapper for a custom type converter function."""\n')
        output_lines.append('    def __init__(self, func):\n')
        output_lines.append('        self.func = func\n')
        output_lines.append('\n')
        output_lines.append('    def __call__(self, string, match):\n')
        output_lines.append('        return self.func(string)\n')
        output_lines.append('\n')
        output_lines.append('\n')
        output_lines.append(line)
        i += 1

    # R9: Fix alignment patterns for search mode

    if "if align == '<':" in line:

        output_lines.append("            s = '%s[^\\s%s]*' % (s, fill)\n")

        i += 1
        continue
    
    # R10: Add slice support to Result.__getitem__
    if '    def __getitem__(self, item):' in line:
        output_lines.append(line)
        i += 1
        # Replace the simple implementation with slice-aware one
        output_lines.append('        if isinstance(item, slice):\n')
        output_lines.append('            return Result(self.fixed[item], {k: v for k, v in self.named.items()}, {k: v for k, v in self.spans.items()})\n')
        output_lines.append('        if isinstance(item, int):\n')
        output_lines.append('            return self.fixed[item]\n')
        output_lines.append('        return self.named[item]\n')
        # Skip original lines
        while i < len(lines) and not lines[i].strip().startswith('def __repr__'):
            i += 1
        continue
    
    output_lines.append(line)
    i += 1

# Write the modified file
with open('/tmp/writable_ws/parse.py', 'w') as f:
    f.writelines(output_lines)

print("Done!")
